case_accounting.independent_reasoning: ATCC1464 defines five salts in 1 L water: CoCl2·6H2O 290 mg, Na2MoO4·2H2O 240 mg, Na2SeO3 17 mg, MnCl2·4H2O 200 mg and ZnSO4·7H2O 280 mg. The selected stock transcribes them without collapsing into the generic Trace Metals owner. The receiving dose is 10 ml, unlike the frozen 10 G_PER_L; that occurrence quantity remains held.

JCM977 adds 100 ml of 20% w/v glucose after cooling. The concentration and unspecified glucose form support a bounded stock. The primary page never specifies stock solvent; 790 ml distilled water is in the basal medium. Selected Water component and verbatim RECIPE_TRANSCRIPTION claim exceed the evidence. Preserve anomer, chirality, hydrate and solvent as unknown or explicitly separate a curator inference. JCM1009's nitrogen handling is a real preparation difference, so equal component arrays alone do not prove duplicate identity.

JCM1188 specifies 2 ml of JCM284 vitamins. JCM284 is the ten-vitamin recipe with 9.5 mg DL-calcium pantothenate and 27.1 mg B12 per L, unlike JCM197. The formula is supported, but source-local numbered pointer synonyms remain globally resolving RAW_TEXT. Preserve provenance with REJECTED_LABEL and route by occurrence.

One gram glucose does not establish anomer or starting hydrate. Keeping occurrence-specific preparation and withholding the whole phrase as a chemical alias is justified.

ATCC461 defines 2x Castenholz basal salts, including literal NaCl 0.016 g, nested Nitsch solution 2 ml and 0.03% FeCl3 solution 2 ml. Selected parent/nested quantities preserve that scope. H3BO4 in the nested source is not silently repaired. Unknown titrant amount at pH 8.2 and unresolved nested form prevent analytical closure; UNKNOWN is appropriate.

COMPLETE concerns listed inputs, not final species or final volume; NaOH quantity and post-neutralization speciation stay unknown.
